shortDescription: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan appointed Muhsin Atci, head of the country’s tax inspection board, to lead Turkey’s market regulator in response to an investment fund crisis that rocked financial markets, Bloomberg reported.

title: Turkey Names Muhsin Atci to Lead Market Regulator Amid Fund Crisis
